description: This file defines a class AnnotateTypesWithSchema that uses Python function signatures to annotate types for nodes within a Torch FX graph, specifically handling standard torch.nn modules, functional calls, and attribute fetches.

classes.name: AnnotateTypesWithSchema
classes.description: A Transformer subclass that annotates FX graph nodes with Python type information based on function signatures and module attributes.

methods.name: call_function
methods.description: Annotates the return type of a function call node in the FX graph based on Python function signatures and boolean dispatch logic.

methods.name: call_module
methods.description: Annotates the return type of a module call node in the FX graph based on the module's forward method signature.

methods.name: get_attr
methods.description: Annotates attribute fetch nodes with inferred TorchScript types if available.

methods.name: _extract_python_return_type
methods.description: Extracts the Python return annotation from a callable target if available.
